paragraphs.text:
Make a Listen roll:
• If successful, go to 55. 
• If successful and you also have a gun, you can choose to go up 
to the pilots’ cabin to see what’s happening, go to 44. 
• If you failed the Listen roll, you lay low in your seat, go to 39. 
(55, 59, 76, 99)
